description: Create a video/audio processing job. Use list_tools first to find the right tool and options. Returns a job ID — use get_job to check status and get the result URL. Needs a paid plan (Lite or higher). Non-AI results are included in the plan; AI results cost AI credits, charged when the result is ready.

durationMs.description: Input duration in milliseconds (for credit estimation)

height.description: Input height in pixels (for credit estimation)

options.description: Tool-specific options (see list_tools for available options)

webhook.description: HTTPS URL to receive a POST when the job completes or fails

width.description: Input width in pixels (for credit estimation)

name: create_job

creditsReserved.description: Always 0: nothing is held when a job is created

estimatedCredits.description: What the AI result should cost, charged when it's ready (0 for non-AI tools, which are included in the plan)

title: Create Processing Job
